info.name: Booking API
info.description:
Walks the whole booking flow. Run it top to bottom (Collection Runner or one by one):
each request saves the tokens and ids the next ones need as collection variables.

Every run registers fresh accounts and reads the emailed codes from Mailpit, so the whole
collection runs unattended against a local setup (`docker compose up -d`, `npm run dev`).
Registration is rate limited to 5 per hour per IP, so that's 2 full runs per hour.

The public demo sends no emails, so registration can't be completed there: try it
from its /docs page with the demo accounts listed in the README.

Full reference: {{baseUrl}}/docs
